appearance: Dense, rounded spiny shrub with small paddle-shaped leaves, often burgundy or purple; small yellow flowers in spring; bright red oval berries hang on through winter.

Low trailing evergreen groundcover with glossy dark green oval leaves in pairs and five-petalled blue-violet flowers in spring; forms dense mats.
Very tall, dense reed grass with stiff hollow stems, long flat blue-green leaves and large fluffy purple-tan seed heads; dead stalks stand through winter.
Broad, dense shade tree with wide five-lobed leaves (some cultivars deep purple) that ooze milky sap when the stalk is snapped; yellow-green flowers in spring; widely spread winged seeds.

Evergreen climbing or trailing vine with glossy dark green three- to five-lobed leaves; clings to trees and walls with aerial rootlets; dark berries on mature growth.
Sprawling thicket of thick arching canes with large hooked thorns; leaves of three to five toothed leaflets; white to pink flowers and large black blackberries in late summer.
Rounded, arching shrub with lobed leaves (green, or burgundy to purple in many cultivars); clusters of small white to pale pink flowers in early summer; peeling bark in strips.
Upright, rounded shrub with glossy oval leaves that turn bright red to orange-red in fall; clusters of small white flowers in spring; dark purple-black berries.
Low woodland groundcover with large soft heart-shaped leaves in pairs forming a dense carpet; small hidden maroon cup-shaped flowers at ground level in spring.
Medium to large shade tree with three- to five-lobed toothed leaves that turn bright red in fall; clusters of tiny red flowers before the leaves in early spring; red-winged seeds.
Upright evergreen shrub with glossy, holly-like spiny leaflets that turn bronze-purple in winter; dense clusters of bright yellow flowers in spring; dusty blue berries.
Low, trailing evergreen mat with small glossy leathery oval leaves on reddish stems; small pink-white urn-shaped flowers in spring; bright red berries.
